polls.description: Anthropic's massive $65B funding round at $965B valuation represents the largest AI company financing ever, surpassing OpenAI's valuation.
polls.question: Is Anthropic's $965B valuation justified or a dangerous bubble?

cluster_stories.title: Anthropic nears $1 trillion valuation, zooms past OpenAI after latest funding round
cluster_stories.summary: The company’s valuation has more than doubled from $380 billion in February, reflecting its swift rise as a leading competitor in the AI race and intense investor demand for stakes in frontier companies. Anthropic said its run-rate revenue crossed $47 billion earlier this month.
cluster_stories.headline: ANTHROPIC NEARS $1 TRILLION VALUATION... ZOOMS PAST OPENAI

cluster_stories.title: Anthropic finalises $65bn funding deal to surpass OpenAI’s valuation
cluster_stories.summary: New round values Claude AI maker at $965bn including the new money
cluster_stories.headline: ANTHROPIC CLOSES $65B ROUND... $965B VALUATION BEATS OPENAI

cluster_stories.title: Anthropic Raises $65 Billion in Funding Round, Eclipses OpenAI
cluster_stories.summary: Anthropic PBC raised $65 billion in a funding round that valued the artificial intelligence company at $965 billion including the new investment, eclipsing rival OpenAI’s value for the first time. Ed Ludlow reports on "Bloomberg The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)
cluster_stories.headline: ANTHROPIC RAISES $65B, ECLIPSES OPENAI AT $965B VALUATION

cluster_stories.title: What’s rarer than a unicorn? Anthropic didn’t just join the Series H club, it almost became the first $1 trillion private company ever
cluster_stories.summary: The $65 billion funding round was led by Altimeter, Dragoneer, Greenoaks and Sequoia, more than doubling the company's valuation in just three months.
cluster_stories.headline: ANTHROPIC RAISES $65B, NEARLY HITS $1 TRILLION VALUATION

cluster_stories.title: Anthropic raises $65 billion, nears $1T valuation ahead of IPO
cluster_stories.summary: Anthropic has closed a $65 billion Series H round at a $965 billion post-money valuation, marking what could be the AI startup's final private fundraise before a highly anticipated IPO.
cluster_stories.headline: ANTHROPIC RAISES $65B... NEARS $1T VALUATION

cluster_stories.title: Anthropic Valued at $965 Billion After Latest Funding Round, Eclipsing OpenAI
cluster_stories.summary: Anthropic PBC raised $65 billion in a funding round that valued the artificial intelligence company at $965 billion including the new investment, eclipsing rival OpenAI’s value for the first time.
cluster_stories.headline: ANTHROPIC ECLIPSES OPENAI... $965B VALUATION

cluster_stories.title: Apollo Shops $36 Billion Debt Deal to Buy Google Chips for Anthropic
cluster_stories.summary: Apollo Global Management Inc. and Blackstone Inc. are working to bring additional investors into a roughly $36 billion debt financing deal to help Anthropic PBC build out its AI infrastructure.
cluster_stories.headline: APOLLO SHOPS $36B DEBT DEAL FOR ANTHROPIC CHIP INFRASTRUCTURE

cluster_stories.title: Anthropic Nears $1T Valuation And Leapfrogs OpenAI On Unicorn Board With $65B Funding Round
cluster_stories.summary: Generative AI company Anthropic announced on Thursday that it has raised $65 billion in a Series H funding round, more than doubling its post-money valuation to a staggering $965 billion.
cluster_stories.headline: ANTHROPIC HITS NEAR-$1T VALUATION... Leapfrogs OpenAI

cluster_stories.title: Anthropic to roll out Claude Mythos in coming weeks, launches Opus 4.8
cluster_stories.summary: Mythos ​is the AI ​lab's large language model with advanced ‌cybersecurity capabilities that have ​raised concerns ​among ⁠executives and world leaders about its ​impact.
cluster_stories.headline: ANTHROPIC LAUNCHES OPUS 4.8, ANNOUNCES CLAUDE MYTHOS ROLLOUT

cluster_stories.title: Anthropic raises $65 billion, now valued at $965 billion
cluster_stories.headline: ANTHROPIC VALUED AT $965B... RAISES $65B

polls.description: Anthropic's massive $65B funding round at nearly $1 trillion valuation surpasses OpenAI as the highest-valued AI company.
